8.3 Function definitions
The SOME/IP transformer provides the specific interfaces generally required by [3, ASWS Transformer General].
[SWS_SomeIpXf_00150] Upstream requirements: SRS_Xfrm_00106
⌈The SOME/IP Transformer shall only provide functions for transformers where the TransformationTechnology is referenced as the first reference in the list of ordered references transformerChain from a DataTransformation to a TransformationTechnology.⌋ That means, only the first transformer in a transformer chain can be a SOME/IP Transformer because serializer transformer are in general only allowed to be the first transformer in a chain.
